fr_html: M. DE LAPRADELLE, dans ces circonstances, retire l'article 30, et LORD PHILLIMORE en propose la suppression.
en_html: M. DE LAPRADELLE, in these circumstances, withdrew Article 30, and LORD PHILLIMORE proposed that it should be deleted.
